purpose: Reproduce the original pre-response binding stream byte-for-byte from its public header/order and three complete owner partitions. This verifies representation only, not the semantic adequacy of any binding.
path_base: The directory containing PRE_RESPONSE_BINDING_HEADER_AND_ORDER.json and the three PRE_RESPONSE_BINDINGS_*.json inputs. No workspace, attachment, network or historical absolute path is required or dereferenced.

steps.rule: For each input, match bytes and SHA256 before parsing; fail on a mismatch. Do not fetch replacement inputs.
Decode UTF-8 without a BOM; retain every object member order, array order, number, Unicode scalar and value. Do not normalize strings or interpret field contents.
Keep each entire execution object and its internal property order unchanged; no fields or nested values are dropped.
Require exactly the same set of unique IDs in the index and the90-element order array; lookup complete objects in that explicit order. Reject missing, extra or duplicate IDs.

Insert keys in the recorded top-level order. For the executions key insert the restored array. For every other key copy its entire existing header value, retaining nested object order. Require exact key-set coverage; no inferred/default keys.
Use conventional JSON pretty serialization equivalent to json.dumps(object, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, sort_keys=False) plus exactly one LF. Nested insertion order must not be sorted.
Report failure if either identity differs. Hash equality is the decisive serialization check, not a claim of semantic review.

output.publication_note: The reconstructed large stream is an optional local verification product, not an additional maintained public artifact; the individually bounded public partitions/header remain the preservation representation.

safety_and_scope: No private source path, signed URL, attachment, narrative paragraph or hidden evaluator field content is embedded in this recipe.
Copy binding fields opaquely; this procedure does not read or evaluate hidden facts, expected answers, predicates, outcomes or adverse signatures.
Do not alter original models, prompts, first responses, settings, partitions, candidate files or canonical/Git state.
This is not model adoption, suite acceptance, publication, a reconstruction freeze, behavioral validation or a new source admission.
